notes.title: Picture Perfect v1.1
notes.content: [p]Hi, everyone. I'm not sure if you've heard or not, but some games with more sensitive themes have been removed from Steam recently, so an update has had to be made to this game, but don't worry 99% of the story remains the same in terms of the story and dialogue. This minor change also means I'll be able to consider sequels in the future without worrying about bans or delistings.[/p][p][/p][p](If there are any typos or bugs, please make sure to post them here, but I'm working hard to make sure this clean version is polished.)[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for understanding and a lot more good stuff coming soon.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changelog[/b][/p][p][/p][p]- Compliance with new Steam content guidelines[/p]

notes.title: Walkthrough mod and scene gallery added for Picture Perfect!
notes.content:
Hi, everyone! I just wanted to let you know that there have been some quality of life changes to Picture Perfect. 

1) The PDF walkthrough has been upgraded to an in-game walkthrough. If you already have the walkthrough purchased, simply update the game when you go play like normal, and the new PDF you see will contain the password for activating it in the game when you start a new game. You can look at the walkthrough store page for a step-by-step guide if you are having trouble. 

2) A scene gallery has been added so you can replay scenes. The new button is on the main opening screen. You do have to unlock them first, however, by playing through the game.

3) I am currently working on trying to find an animator to add animations to the game, so I will keep you all informed about that if I do find one!

Thank you for the support as always. And I hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Picture Perfect is now complete!
notes.content:
Finally, huh, guys??? Picture Perfect is now finally complete and ready to be played. The Early Access version had 9 updates and this final version has 14 in all, so 5 updates have been included. 

For everyone who already bought the game, just launch it like normal and it should update for you as long as you have that enabled. And please be aware that you should be starting a new game!

Also, just a small side note that the walkthrough will be updated in a day or two, and is still currently up to .9. Really sorry about that, just having a little trouble with the uploading but it should be resolved in a day or two like I said! (06/15/21 of this post)

Enjoy, guys, and please let me know what you think or if you have any trouble!

notes.title: Picture Perfect 0.9 Now available!
notes.content:
So, guys. I have been working for the last couple of months on revamping the entire game, adding much better lighting which make the characters and scenes look more like life and feel more realistic, new skin that makes them look so much more real, better clothes and new environments.

The story is totally untouched, I have only upgraded the images!

ANDDD, this revamped version 0.9 contains a whole new update that focuses on Sasha! I know you guys will love it

-- All you have to do is open the game and let it update when it asks you!
